title: Convenient way to give new live to your sectional but attracts cat hair
text:
Convenient way to give new live to your sectional but attracts cat hair. This is a great way to give new live to your sectional. Make sure you measure your sectional first since they do come in different sizes. It takes a few minutes to spread it over it and voila you have a new sofa. It is super easy to use and helps cover up the old worm out material.

It is made out of microfiber so it will attract new cat hair. I used this to cover up the sofa since I just can't get the cat hair out of the old one anymore for guest visits and then either take it off or put another more heavy duty cover over it. I am not going to lie this really is almost a cat hair magnet but I like how it looks. It does take a bit of tweaking but fits quite nicely.

All in all a decent find and for those pet owners out there looking for a solution it works but it has its limitations.
